data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss events during the calendar year, as well as favourable loss development which resulted in releases from prior year reserves. US Casualty business has faced difficult market conditions for some time as loss experience has been relatively benign in recent years. The book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced favorable prior year development in 2014, leading to reserve releases. This was primarily driven by benign claims experience and a lack of major loss events in prior years, particularly benefiting the Property and US Casualty lines of business. The specific gross amount of these releases is not quantified in the report.

possible again to release reserves from prior years

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development amount is not quantified in the report; only the direction (releases) and affected lines of business are mentioned in the narrative. Percentages for gross premium mix are rounded to two decimal places.
